primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." The auction game is rigged against small business. Developers have deeper pockets and they don't care about overpaying — they'll subdivide and flip. You just need somewhere to run your business. These new Truganina warehouses are sold at a fixed price directly to owner-occupiers. No auction stress. No getting gazumped. Secure your warehouse off the plan near Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Stop competing with developers. Start owning.
description: Fixed-price purchase with no auctions and no developer competition
